summary.text: Stacey McDuffie is the Democratic candidate for the Michigan House of Representatives, District 51, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Matt Maddock. A Realtor and businesswoman, she says she is running for transparent, fiscally responsible state government.

paragraphs.text: Stacey McDuffie described herself in a 2026 Ballotpedia survey as a business professional, Realtor, Army spouse and mother of two daughters.
She said her career has included leadership roles with the NBA and Lockheed Martin.
She advanced from the Democratic primary on August 4, 2026.
In the survey, McDuffie listed transparent budgeting and accountable government, school quality and teacher support, and affordability for working families as her key messages.
She also named support for veterans and military families and infrastructure among her policy interests.
